name: scroll-text-marquee
blurb: Text scrolls horizontally as a marquee.
description: Horizontally scrolling text loop, typically used for news tickers or flowing announcements.
use_when: News feeds, announcements, or atmospheric section backgrounds.
avoid_when: Critical content — marquee speed makes text skimmable but not stoppable.
a11y: Text scrolls continuously with no pause control. Screen readers may see the loop.
